funds.note: Calculated from FY26 portfolio dollar values ($9.8bn office, $3.6bn industrial, of a $15.3bn total portfolio) reported in Dexus's FY26 results release. Dexus does not publish an official sector weighting percentage table in its headline results; the remaining ~12% is unallocated in the source figures.

Calculated from 1H26 investment property net income by segment ($138.7m retail, $124.0m office, $80.3m logistics) reported in GPT's 1H26 results presentation. This is an income-share split, not an asset-value weighting, and is not an officially published percentage table.

Calculated from invested capital by segment ($5.0bn office, $2.2bn retail, $2.0bn industrial, $0.8bn living, totalling $10.0bn) reported in Mirvac's FY26 results presentation. This is an asset-value weighting, the most direct of the calculated splits in this tool, but still not an officially published percentage table.

Directly published portfolio weighting table in Stockland's FY26 results presentation (p.~17). The only fund in this tool with an officially reported sector percentage split rather than a calculated one. Masterplanned and Land Lease are residential development segments with no comparable cap rate basis.

coverage_note: Sector exposure is available for Dexus, GPT and Mirvac (calculated from figures in their results releases) and Stockland (directly reported). The other 4 tracked funds don't publish a clean sector-split table in their headline ASX announcements; getting their sector weightings would need a line-by-line read of each fund's full results presentation or annual report.
